newsitem.title: USA: Costello says doesn't comment on others' policies.
newsitem.headline: Costello says doesn't comment on others' policies.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said he did not comment on other countries' policies and used the word "fanciful" when asked about a report in the Australian Financial Review.

In an interview, after a meeting with Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, Costello was quoted by the newspaper as saying Greenspan was "very optimistic" on inflation. Costello also said he thought there was little expectation that interest rates in the U.S. would rise.
"I don't comment on other countries...policies," Costello said when asked by Reuters about the article. When read portions of the report, Costello said "that's fanciful."
Costello is attending the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank here.
The Federal Reserve confirmed that Greenspan and Costello met Monday but declined to comment on what was discussed.
